codesFaq.question: How do I redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: Open the game, click the settings gear in the top-right, paste your code into the Redeem Code field, and confirm. Codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why do codes stop working?
codesFaq.answer: Codes expire on a schedule set by the developer (usually monthly or tied to update milestones), and some are one-per-account. This page is re-tested regularly.

codesFaq.question: How often are new codes released?
codesFaq.answer: New codes typically arrive with each major game update. Bookmark this page and check back after every patch.

codesFaq.question: Do codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Yes — most codes have an expiry date, shown next to each code. Expired codes move to the expired table below.

items.question: What is 1in8b?
items.answer: 1in8b is an independent website for discovering games and finding practical information about how to play them. We bring together official game links, controls, gameplay guides, and answers to common questions.

items.question: Can I play games directly on 1in8b?
items.answer: Game pages provide links to official places to play when available. Some games can be played directly in your browser on their official websites.

items.question: Are your game guides official?
items.answer: No. Our guides are independently written and are not official documentation from the game developers unless clearly stated otherwise.

items.question: How can I find help for a specific game?
items.answer: Search for the game or open it from the game directory. Each game page brings together the information currently available, such as controls, game modes, tips, and frequently asked questions.

items.question: Why isn't a particular game listed?
items.answer: Our collection grows over time. We focus on games with player interest and useful information to share, rather than trying to list every game.

items.question: What if a guide is outdated or incorrect?
items.answer: Please contact us with the page URL and the information that needs updating. Game features can change, and corrections help keep our guides useful.
